reviews.author: root

plan.purpose: bounded observational persistent-grid cap comparison, not promotion eligible
plan.hypothesis: Exact GPU-validated persistent-v2 kernel, Bank.prepare grid cap 8*SMs (1056 on H200). Test dispatch reduction versus occupancy/latency-hiding tradeoff without kernel math changes. Compare against unchanged baseline-v2.
plan.execution_note: Fixed sweep order8SM,2SM,16SM; one attempt/cap, seed930031 shared to match fixtures across separate runs. Same existing rsi_pair20pairs4shapes. Root supplies independent review and live per-cap lease. No GPU execution by preparer. Keep per-cap private cache; unchanged SGLang same-candidate-role preseed allowed only before worker start, no forced cache validity bypass.
plan.stop_policy: One attempt each. Stop sweep on compile/correctness/nonfinite/timeout/ownership failure; retain evidence and prove processes terminal before closing lease. Ordinary measured regressions do not trigger retries or change remaining fixed-order caps.
plan.measurement: 20 raw paired graph replay samples per shape; cold128MiB flush; matched actual inputbytes, everytimedoutput officialreferencechecked. Report all4shapes, rawarrays and descriptivegeomean; no calibratedsignificance/promotion claim.
plan.next_decision: Descriptive comparison only; fixed cap order may confound drift, balanced AB/BA protects each baseline comparison but does not calibrate inter-cap significance. Pick next hypothesis only after all admitted caps or explicit stop; no promotion/holdout claims.
